command: node --input-type=module -e 'import assert from "node:assert/strict"; import TinyQueue from "./src/index.js"; let seed=42; const rand=()=>((seed=(Math.imul(seed,1664525)+1013904223)>>>0)/4294967296); for (const compare of [(a,b)=>a-b,(a,b)=>b-a,(a,b)=>a.priority-b.priority]) { const object=compare.toString().includes("priority"); const value=()=>object?{priority:Math.floor(rand()*30)}:Math.floor(rand()*30); for(let run=0;run<50;run++){const initial=Array.from({length:run},value);const expected=initial.slice();const q=new TinyQueue(initial,compare);for(let i=0;i<500;i++){expected.sort(compare);assert.equal(q.length,expected.length);assert.equal(q.peek(),expected[0]);if(rand()<0.55){const v=value();q.push(v);expected.push(v);}else{const popped=q.pop();if(expected.length){assert.equal(compare(popped,expected[0]),0);expected.splice(expected.indexOf(popped),1);}else assert.equal(popped,undefined);}}while(expected.length){expected.sort(compare);const popped=q.pop();assert.equal(compare(popped,expected[0]),0);expected.splice(expected.indexOf(popped),1);}assert.equal(q.peek(),undefined);assert.equal(q.pop(),undefined);assert.equal(q.data.length,0);const v=value();q.push(v);assert.equal(q.pop(),v);assert.equal(q.length,0);assert.equal(q.peek(),undefined);}} console.log("Randomized constructor, interleaving, comparator, and reuse checks passed");'
